meta.name: The Fall and Rise of Reggie Dinkins
meta.description: A disgraced former football player is on a mission to rehabilitate his image.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Twenty years after a career-ending scandal, former running back Reggie Dinkins enlists filmmaker Arthur Tobin to make a documentary he hopes will rehabilitate his image.

videos.title: Nittany Means Big
videos.overview: Tobin spends the day with Monica and uncovers the truth about Reggie's famous food poisoning game; Reggie struggles to apologize to Brina.

videos.title: Put It on Your Cabbage!
videos.overview: Tobin urges Reggie to leave the house and face the outside world. Monica learns there's more to Brina than meets the eye.

videos.title: Save the Cat
videos.overview: Reggie thinks finding his former coach's lost cat will help him get into the Hall of Fame. Monica gets back in the dating game.

videos.title: You May Hug Your Hero
videos.overview: Reggie and Monica restart their youth football camp and face off against their old rivals, Jerry and Tisha Basmati.

videos.title: Dr. Watson's Dad
videos.overview: When one of Reggie's most prized possessions goes missing, he must gather all the suspects and uncover whodunnit.

videos.title: The World Is Full of Beaks
videos.overview: Tobin tries to keep his personal life separate from the documentary, but Reggie doesn't make it easy for him; Monica helps Brina with her music career.

videos.title: The Loyalty Swamp
videos.overview: Tobin's past comes back to haunt him; Reggie and Brina struggle to set a wedding date.

videos.title: Mischief and Memories
videos.overview: The Dinkins family bands together for their annual push to get Reggie into the Hall of Fame, but Jerry Basmati stands in their way.

videos.title: A Real Cinderello Story
videos.overview: Monica tries to sign an exciting new prospect. Unexpectedly, Jerry Basmati takes revenge on Reggie.

videos.title: We Keep the Kisses
videos.overview: Reggie and Monica struggle to capitalize on new opportunities. Carmelo's secret relationship with their rivals' daughter threatens to tear the family apart.

videos.title: The Spaghetti Loop
videos.overview: Tobin and Rusty both attempt to become financially independent from the Dinkins family.

videos.title: Hulk Want Candy
videos.overview: For the first time since the divorce, Monica is in a serious relationship and Reggie is having trouble accepting it. Brina pursues an exciting new opportunity in her music career.

videos.title: Turkey Can Be This
videos.overview: It's Thanksgiving at the Dinkins house and Brina is eager to prove herself to Reggie's mother, Gigi.
